title: Slow requests on a product API
symptoms: Slow request GET /api/products/1234 took 2500ms, appearing a few times per hour. Some requests take 1-3 seconds while most are fast. No errors, just slow responses.
root_cause: Some queries miss an index or a cache, or a cold cache after deploy makes the first requests slow.
impact: Minor: some users wait a few seconds. No data loss and no outage.
fix_steps: Find the slowest endpoints in the logs and check their database queries with EXPLAIN.
Add the missing index or cache the hot query.
Only escalate if the rate of slow requests grows or the 95th percentile latency breaches the SLO.
prevention: Track p95 latency per endpoint, review slow-query logs weekly, and warm caches after deploys.
